compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Only ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off to UVEK qualifies. Preserve signed caller quantities and supported uncertainty. No consequential, inverse or other-release approval is inferred. These are screening proxies with unquantified score effects; native biosphere exclusions and historical technology/allocation/uncertainty remain limitations. Construct a fixed one-kg 85%-slag variant of the complete native CEM III/B no-burdens cement finishing inventory. Retain source 0.85 kg delivered GGBFS, 0.1425 kg clinker and 0.0075 kg delivered mineral gypsum, including their source formulas and supported uncertainty. Their central binder mass sums to one kg; no claim of sampled compositional closure is made. Remove only the native prototype incoming road/rail delivery rows, which the two replacement material-market helpers supply. Retain native finishing fuel, electricity quantity, waste heat, grinding aid, steel, plant and uncertainty; rebind the site medium-voltage electricity to US. Native 0.2336 MJ fuel-burning service is not equated to source 0.272 MJ useful heat; do not add source finishing energy or an efficiency correction. Native finishing performance, clinker geography, grade/strength, allocation, vintage and internal uncertainty are proxies. Cement parameter is fixed at one kg to retain the source binder formulas. This is a source-composition variant, not an assertion of identical cement performance.

mining-38-row-delivered-mineral-gypsum.rationale: Only ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off to UVEK qualifies. Preserve signed caller quantities and supported uncertainty. No consequential, inverse or other-release approval is inferred. These are screening proxies with unquantified score effects; native biosphere exclusions and historical technology/allocation/uncertainty remain limitations. Use complete native Swiss mineral gypsum at mine per kg as a stock proxy and retain all eleven source final-delivery freight entries separately. This replaces both source stock producers, including the 0.0615230787% zinc-production co-product, with the quarry model; their original allocation is not reconstructed and no zinc recovery credit is added. The source cement comment mentions FGD gypsum but its actual exchange purchases mineral gypsum; follow that exchange, with no calcination or moisture correction. Sea bulk carrier uses the native generic transoceanic ship, national rail uses RER mixed traction, light-commercial freight uses the native 3.5t fleet and other road freight uses the native general fleet. Geography, mode technology, loading, vintage and joint uncertainty differ.
